finding.text: Fix 2 breaks the "fallback wrote first" guarantee for a real tab. `RecordWriter.post` now sends `client` on every verb (`core/Item/RecordWriter.js:56`), but the stamped lines it hands back as `rest` for the fallback carry no `client` (line 51). So the line the tab appends through `Append.js` is keyed `owner|ts`, while the late post is checked with `c:<client>|ts` (`Servex/agents/page_tools.js:149`). They never match, the late post writes a second line, and `doc/one-writer.md:231` ("the late post is answered `{already: true}`") is no longer true. `one-writer.test.mjs:103` still passes only because its late verb is posted without a `client`, which no real tab does any more. The fix: put `client` on the verb lines in `list` too, so the fallback line carries it, and add a case 3 variant that uses the real tab shape.

Fix 1 says "newline guard before **every** append" (fixes.md 1), and `core/doc/status.md`'s Phase 0 row now says "Done". But only `RecordWriter.append_once` has the guard. The two main append paths still append blind: the entry point's `write_line` (`Servex/agents/page_tools.js:183`, used by every `record_lines` and item-tool write) and the dev server's fallback (`Server/plugins/SocketServer/Append.js:131`). Either add the guard there with a test, or change the status row to say what is really covered.

Fix 5 changes the on-disk shape of every browser `List.add`: fields now sit under `data` instead of flat (`core/List/List.js:254-263`). Nobody checked the readers that read an `add` payload flat instead of through `hydrate()`. Examples: `ai/rail/rail.js:484` (`fold.content?.add?.text ?? …title`), `ai/cards/Activity.js:143` and `ai/AISession/SessionTimelineRows.js:97`. A card added to a page's content list from the browser would now show blank in those summaries. Do the census, then fix each reader or say why it can't receive these lines.

The F4 helper is a static on `Runtime` (`Server/plugins/SocketServer/Runtime.js:50`), and `rpc:write` is its only caller. fixes.md asks for "one crash-safe rewrite helper". Other rewriters still truncate in place: `Server/SessionConsolidate.mjs:110,132` uses plain `writeFileSync`. Consider moving the helper somewhere shared and listing its callers in status.md.

`safe_write` creates a `<file>.tmp-<pid>-<ms>` sibling inside the watched `public/` tree. LiveReload mutes only the real path (`Runtime.js:36`), so every save also queues a change for the tmp path, which is sent to every tab (`LiveReload.js:143-185`). That is probably harmless, because tabs ignore paths they didn't load, but it hasn't been checked.

Fix 2's second clause in fixes.md ("the item tool's own stamps repeat too (the flaky one-writer test)") is not addressed or mentioned. Fix 3 is marked "already built" with no test. The brief allows the skip, but status.md should link to the code that proves it (`ext/JSONL/live.js`, the `Socket.prototype.open` override).

Scope: this diff is step 1 (Phase 0) of the 8 steps only. Steps 2–8 (Ref/F7, Refs in `session.messages`, List-view hooks, `Sentence.at` + `Prompt.raw`, Prompt kind/items, session completion, the V1 compare) are not in it. Child task `s1` on `session.jsonl` is started but not completed. A fresh agent could continue from `plan.md` + `builder.md`.
